name: Following The Will Of God
overview: Following the will of God is central to entering His kingdom, as Jesus teaches that not everyone who calls Him Lord will enter, but only those who do the will of the Father in heaven. Prayer begins with honoring God's name, reflecting a heart aligned with His purposes. Jesus demonstrates His authority to forgive sins and calls believers to respond in obedience, illustrating that faith is active and transformative. Recognizing Jesus as the Son of God and the bread of life from heaven is foundational to living in accordance with God's will, which brings peace and eternal life.
